file_insights.changes: Added date range filter functionality to material_list view
key_modifications: Imported datetime module for date parsing
Added date_from and date_to query parameters extraction
Implemented date range filtering with error handling
Passed filter parameters to template context for UI persistence
file_insights.impact: Enables users to filter materials by creation date range in the list view

patterns_discovered.description: Standard Django pattern of extracting GET parameters with default empty strings

patterns_discovered.pattern: Date String Parsing with Error Handling
patterns_discovered.description: Try-except blocks to safely parse date strings and silently ignore invalid formats
Multiple sequential filter() calls on QuerySet to apply different filter conditions
Passing filter parameters back to template context to maintain filter state on page reload

gotchas_discovered.description: ValueError exceptions from invalid date formats are silently caught with 'pass', providing no user feedback
gotchas_discovered.risk: Users may unknowingly provide invalid dates without knowing the filter wasn't applied
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider adding error messages to context or returning validation errors to user

gotchas_discovered.description: Hardcoded '%Y-%m-%d' format assumes consistent user input format
gotchas_discovered.risk: International users or different input mechanisms may provide dates in different formats
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Use HTML5 date input type which standardizes format, or implement more flexible parsing

gotchas_discovered.description: Filter parameters default to empty strings rather than None
gotchas_discovered.risk: Requires truthy check for empty strings; falsy behavior may differ if None was used
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consistent approach, but ensure all downstream code handles empty strings appropriately

approach_outcome.summary: Date range filter successfully implemented in material_list view
approach_outcome.methodology: Direct modification approach - added filter logic inline with existing filter conditions
approach_outcome.completion: Full first-attempt success with proper error handling and context passing

recommendations.recommendation: Implement validation error messages for invalid date formats instead of silent failures
recommendations.rationale: Users should know when their filter input is invalid to improve UX

recommendations.recommendation: Use HTML5 <input type='date'> elements in template for standardized date picking
recommendations.rationale: Browser-native date picker ensures consistent format and better UX across devices

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extracting date filtering logic into a separate method or utility function
recommendations.rationale: Improves testability and reduces view method complexity as more filters are added

recommendations.recommendation: Add docstring comments explaining the date filter parameter format expectations
recommendations.rationale: Future maintainers and API consumers will understand the expected date format
